Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Ministry of Admission desk. Active goal: finish document processing and advance. Latest confirmed view is the agent's reading of the screenshot after drag ~0.12/0.88 to ~0.5/0.95 and before upward drag ~0.5/0.92 to ~0.5/0.8: AUDIO TRANSCRIPT still centered at the bottom overlapping the slot; partial slot text ENTS HERE visible to the right; passport still on the bottom-left brown desk panel, date read as 02.11.23; M.O.A. button showed a white circle (changed from crossed-out in the prior confirmed view; causation unconfirmed); cursor over the transcript; bulletin not visible; silver object previously seen at top-right remains absent. That view confirms drag ~0.12/0.88 to ~0.5/0.95 did not relocate the passport, process the transcript, stamp, or advance. After that view, upward drag ~0.5/0.92 to ~0.5/0.8 completed with no confirming screenshot; outcome unknown.

Passport (observed): remained on the desk through the latest confirmed view. Completed drags from ~0.28/0.48, ~0.18/0.78, ~0.15/0.85, drag ~0.15/0.85 to ~0.5/0.95, and both drags ~0.12/0.88 to ~0.5/0.95 toward the slot did not relocate it. Slot clicks ~0.5/0.95 did not move it. Click ~0.15/0.85 and click ~0.12/0.88 are confirmed not to have moved it. An earlier drag ~0.12/0.88 to ~0.5/0.95 may have surfaced the transcript; unconfirmed.

Stamp (observed): M.O.A. clicks and drags while crossed out did not stamp or advance. White-circle and crossed-out appearances have alternated more than once with no visible stamp or page advance. Click ~0.38/0.18 while white did not leave a stamp or advance. Confirmed sequence included white, crossed-out, white, crossed-out, white, crossed-out, white, crossed-out, white, crossed-out, white, crossed-out, then white again in the newest confirmed view. Whether any click or drag caused those reversions is unconfirmed. Neither state is reliable evidence of readiness. Both clicks ~0.38/0.18 (while white, and later while crossed out) did not stamp or advance.

Bulletin (observed): CONTENTS titled Arstotzkan Ministry of Admission RULES & REGULATIONS, with Basic Rules, Regional Map, Booth Info. CONTENTS does not confirm older page readings; a prior page 3/4 claim was contradicted and stays unconfirmed. Confirmed views: page 2/4 about attention to passport, then a RULES page reading Entrant must have a passport and Arstotzkan citizens only. Unconfirmed clicks before RULES: ~0.6/0.75, ~0.6/0.8, ~0.62/0.82, ~0.63/0.83; no evidence which, if any, selected a menu item. Close attempts: outside click ~0.3/0.5, bottom-edge drag ~0.5/0.85 to ~0.5/0.98, leftward drags ~0.5/0.9 to ~0.1/0.9 and ~0.4/0.9 to ~0.1/0.9. Bulletin later confirmed closed, but which action closed it is uncertain; it had reopened or stayed partly visible after earlier close attempts. Not visible in recent transcript views.

Transcript (observed): light-blue AUDIO TRANSCRIPT has never been confirmed processed or seated. It moved from center toward the lower edge overlapping the slot, then after an unconfirmed leftward drag sat bottom-left over the passport area. Later it was bottom-right covering part of the slot and the slot label was gone. Click ~0.7/0.95 left it there. Upward drag ~0.7/0.95 to ~0.7/0.85 left it higher at bottom-right, still partly covering the slot. Downward drag ~0.7/0.85 to ~0.7/0.95 and leftward drag ~0.6/0.9 to ~0.4/0.9 did not process or clearly move it. Drag ~0.65/0.92 to ~0.5/0.95 centered it at the bottom with partial slot text ENTS HERE still visible to the right. Downward drags ~0.5/0.92 to ~0.5/0.98 and ~0.5/0.9 to ~0.5/0.97, click ~0.5/0.9, drag ~0.5/0.88 to ~0.45/0.95, drag ~0.42/0.9 to ~0.5/0.98, upward drag ~0.5/0.9 to ~0.5/0.8, downward drag ~0.5/0.9 to ~0.5/0.97, drag ~0.5/0.9 to ~0.4/0.95, and drag ~0.4/0.92 to ~0.5/0.98 all left it centered and unprocessed. Newest confirmed view again shows it centered and unprocessed.

Failed/ineffective (observed): stamp actions while crossed out did not advance; listed passport-to-slot drags and slot clicks did not relocate the passport; click ~0.15/0.85, click ~0.12/0.88, drag ~0.15/0.85 to ~0.5/0.95, and both drags ~0.12/0.88 to ~0.5/0.95 did not move the passport; click ~0.7/0.95 and upward, downward, leftward, and centering transcript drags did not process it; downward drags to the bottom edge, click ~0.5/0.9, and the listed centering/offset drags left the transcript centered and unprocessed. Outside click and bottom-edge drag were not confirmed to close the bulletin at the time. Both clicks ~0.38/0.18 did not stamp or advance.

Unknown results (completed, no confirming screenshot after, or a later view did not isolate the effect): transcript drags ~0.5/0.75 to ~0.5/0.95, ~0.52/0.85 to ~0.5/0.95, ~0.52/0.92 to ~0.5/0.98; earlier click ~0.5/0.95; drag ~0.2/0.88 to ~0.5/0.95; bulletin drag ~0.4/0.9 to ~0.1/0.9 (bulletin later confirmed closed); transcript drags ~0.5/0.75 to ~0.5/0.95 and ~0.52/0.85 to ~0.7/0.95 (next view: transcript bottom-right, slot label gone); click ~0.7/0.95; downward drag ~0.7/0.85 to ~0.7/0.95; click ~0.5/0.95; leftward drag ~0.6/0.9 to ~0.4/0.9; drag ~0.65/0.92 to ~0.5/0.95 (next view: transcript centered, partial slot text visible). Click ~0.38/0.18 while crossed out: next view showed white circle, transcript still centered, no stamp or advance; whether the click caused the color change is unconfirmed. Drag ~0.5/0.9 to ~0.4/0.95: next view showed transcript still centered and unprocessed, button crossed out; causation unconfirmed. Drag ~0.4/0.92 to ~0.5/0.98: next view showed transcript still centered and unprocessed, button white; causation unconfirmed. Click ~0.12/0.88: next view showed transcript still centered, passport unmoved, button crossed-out; causation of color change unconfirmed. Newly unknown: upward drag ~0.5/0.92 to ~0.5/0.8, no screenshot after. Silver object seen once at top-right, now absent, never tested.
